title: List item outside a list
user_impact: Screen reader users receive no announcement of the list's length/structure.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (F2, H48); HTML §4.4.5-4.4.10 list content models; WAI-ARIA 1.2 list/listitem/term/definition
checks.applicability: Every rendered, not aria-hidden list item: <li> or role="listitem" without another explicit role.
checks.expectation:
A list item whose nearest list ancestor is missing, or has turned into
something other than a list by its role (tablist, menu), fails (F2-like: item
semantics without a list). A list ancestor with role none/presentation passes
the item's semantics on and is no finding. Located at the item. Known host gap
until the a11y-rules release that declares this id in Meta::ids: findings
arrive without a run record (FindingWithoutRun), not to be worked around here.
